terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Renty platform.
terms.intro: By using or accessing Renty, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our platform.
terms.s1Body: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Accurate, complete, and updated information must be provided during registration. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
terms.s2Body: All rentals through Renty constitute a binding agreement between the Renter and the Owner. Items must be returned in the same condition as received, accounting for normal wear and tear. Rental periods, pricing, and availability are set by the Item Owner. Late returns may incur additional fees as specified in the listing.
terms.s3Body: A security deposit may be required for certain items and is held until the item is returned in satisfactory condition. All payments are processed securely through our authorized payment partners. Refunds are subject to our cancellation policy and the specific terms of each rental agreement. Commission fees are non-refundable once a rental period has started.
terms.s4Body: Users must not: misrepresent the condition or ownership of items; engage in fraudulent transactions; use the platform for any illegal purpose; harass, threaten, or abuse other users; attempt to circumvent platform fees or security measures; list prohibited or restricted items. Violation of these terms may result in immediate account suspension.
terms.s5Body: Item owners must provide accurate descriptions, clear photos, and fair pricing. All listed items must be legally owned by the poster and in a safe, working condition. Renty reserves the right to remove listings that violate our guidelines or receive verified complaints from renters.
terms.s6Body: In the event of a dispute between a Renter and an Owner, both parties should first attempt to resolve the issue directly. If a resolution cannot be reached, Renty support may mediate the dispute. Decisions made by support regarding security deposits and compensations are final and binding.
terms.s7Body: Renty acts as a marketplace connecting renters with item owners. We do not own, inspect, or guarantee any items listed on the platform. While we implement verification measures, we are not liable for damages, losses, or injuries resulting from rental transactions. Users agree to indemnify Renty against any claims arising from their use of the platform.
terms.s8Body: Renty reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms without prior notice. Users can delete their accounts at any time through their profile settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we protect your data.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Renty collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information. By using our platform, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly: name, email address, phone number, profile picture, government ID for verification, payment details, and location data. We also collect usage data automatically: device information, IP address, browser type, pages visited, interaction patterns, and app usage analytics.
privacy.s2Body: Your information is used to: create and manage your account; process rental transactions and payments; verify user identity and item ownership; facilitate communication between renters and owners; send important service notifications; improve our platform and user experience; detect and prevent fraud; comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with: other users as necessary to complete rental transactions (e.g., contact info); payment processors to handle transactions securely; verification services to confirm identity; law enforcement when legally required; service providers who assist in our platform operations, under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL/TLS encryption, secure password hashing, regular security audits, and access controls. Payment information is handled by PCI-compliant partners and never stored on our servers. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Transaction records are kept for the period required by applicable tax and financial regulations. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time, subject to legal retention requirements.
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to: access your personal data; correct inaccurate information; request data deletion; export your data in a portable format; opt-out of marketing communications; withdraw consent for data processing. To exercise these rights, contact our support team or use the settings in your profile.
privacy.s7Body: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember preferences, analyze platform usage, and improve performance. Essential cookies are required for the platform to function. You can manage cookie preferences through browser settings, though disabling essential cookies may affect platform functionality.
privacy.s8Body: Renty is not intended for users under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 18, we will take steps to delete that information immediately. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact support.
